name: agentsop-trajectory-to-semantic-ops
description: SOP for distilling reusable semantic operators (data-science operation skills) from agent execution trajectories: read action/observation traces, classify per-task failures, bind data-semantic constraints (input semantics / operation decision / output constraints / validation), and feed bounded edits back through an optimizer such as SkillOpt. Use when mining agent runs for cross-task operation knowledge, when a data-science skill keeps failing on the same operation family (join cardinality, group granularity, unit, time alignment), or when wiring trajectory history into a skill optimizer without polluting the skill body.
